name: Premium Synthetic Bristle Industrial Paint Brush with Wooden Handle
shortDescription: Professional paint brush with 100% solid round tapered (SRT) synthetic bristles, epoxy-locked stainless steel ferrule, and natural lacquered wooden handle.
overview: Engineered for professional painters and industrial applicators, this premium paint brush utilizes 100% solid round tapered (SRT) synthetic filaments designed to deliver supreme paint pickup and controlled release. Unlike cheap animal hair brushes that swell or lose bristles in harsh solvents, these synthetic filaments are chemically inert and epoxy-bonded into a seamless stainless steel ferrule, guaranteeing zero bristle fallout. The fine flagged bristle tips lay down enamel, varnish, polyurethane, and primers with a smooth, streak-free finish.
keyFeatures: 100% Solid Round Tapered (SRT) synthetic bristles maintain stiffness in all paints
Flagged tip filaments hold high paint volume and release with smooth feathering
Epoxy-locked stainless steel ferrule guarantees zero bristle shedding during application
Resistant to aggressive solvents, thinners, turpentine, lacquers, and water-based paints
Ergonomic beavertail handle turned from smooth lacquered natural hardwood
High flex memory: bristles snap back to original shape after washing
Available in standard industrial widths: 1-Inch, 2-Inch, 3-Inch, and 4-Inch

specifications.Ferrule: Rust-Proof Stainless Steel with Epoxy Setting
specifications.Compatible Paints: Enamels, Primers, PU Clearcoats, Epoxy, Emulsions, Varnishes
specifications.Clean-Up: Reusable with proper thinner or water wash

applications: Applying enamel paints to steel railings, pipes, and structural gussets
Precision cutting-in around window frames, cornices, and baseboards
Applying clear polyurethane coats to wood panels and furniture
Workshop machinery touch-ups and primer brush-ins
